test_map_elementwise: test the DataFrame.map method to apply a function element-wise across all values
test_map_na_ignore: test the DataFrame.map method with na_action=ignore to skip NA values during mapping
test_map_kwargs: test the DataFrame.map method passing extra keyword arguments to the mapped function
test_map_keeps_dtype: test the DataFrame.map method preserves original dtypes including sparse arrays
test_map_box_timestamps: test the DataFrame.map method properly boxes Timestamp, Timedelta, and Period types
